summary: AI agent army for smart contract security

invariants.description: The total budget locked in SRPBudget contract should always be equal to the sum of individual budgets.
The SRPPolicy contract should only allow approved intents to be executed.
The VulnerableVault contract should not allow unauthorized access to its funds.

access_control_rules: Only approved intents can be executed by SRPPolicy contract
Only authorized users can access funds in VulnerableVault contract
trust_assumptions: The SRPBudget contract is assumed to be secure and trustworthy
The SRPPolicy contract is assumed to be secure and trustworthy
economic_model: The SRP protocol does not have a clear economic model, but it is designed to provide security auditing services for smart contracts.
